environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in EKS with Istio service mesh. PostgreSQL on RDS with app_user role configured as non-owner with explicit FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on the tenant_records table. Database connection via PgBouncer in transaction mode which ensures SET LOCAL is scoped per-transaction. The HMAC secret is injected via AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation every 24 hours through an ExternalSecret CRD (external-secrets operator v0.9.x). Istio AuthorizationPolicy restricts /internal/* and /api/admin/* paths to source principal cluster.local/ns/platform/sa/admin-service only. Network policy (Cilium L7) denies egress from application pods to instance metadata service (169.254.169.254/32). The Secrets Manager rotation means any extracted key is valid for at most 24 hours, and the Istio policy prevents external access to the token generation endpoint.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, role app_user is NOT table owner, ALTER TABLE tenant_records FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied, RLS policy uses current_setting('app.current_tenant')
config.secret_rotation: AWS Secrets Manager with 24h rotation via external-secrets operator ExternalSecret CRD, rotation lambda updates both Secrets Manager and restarts pods via Karpenter disruption
config.service_mesh_authz: Istio AuthorizationPolicy: deny-admin-external applies to paths /internal/* and /api/admin/*, allows only principal cluster.local/ns/platform/sa/admin-service
config.network_policy: Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy denying egress to 169.254.169.254/32 and restricting ingress to istio-ingressgateway only
config.rls_enforcement: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on table ensures even if SET LOCAL fails, queries return empty set rather than all rows
